Now need to continue with next templates in order: after 20810, then 2895, then 1914397, 1914398, 1914399, 74054. So we need to apply each template sequentially to appropriate intermediate(s) to get at least 6 reactions total. The route must have at least 6 reactions, we have 1 so far. We need to apply subsequent templates to break down the precursors further.

We need to construct a tree where each reaction node has children precursors (mol nodes). The final leaf nodes are simple molecules (maybe commercially available). We need to apply templates to each precursor as needed to reach depth 6.

We have two precursors from first step. Likely we will apply next template to one of them, maybe the larger one (the one with many groups). Let's apply template 2895 to the first precursor "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1".
